en.title: A-U-P-P
en.decryption: The hierarchy of Shvetambara canonical literature: The 12 Angas are the primary texts, followed by 12 Upangas (subsidiary).

fact.en: Do not confuse 'Purvas' (early texts) with 'Agamas' (canonical texts); Purvas are largely considered lost.

fact.en: Digambara sect does not accept the Shvetambara canon as authentic; they rely on their own tradition of Sharavanabelagola/Mathura texts.

fact.en: Jain literature was primarily written in Prakrit (Ardha-Magadhi, Shauraseni) and later in Sanskrit, not Pali (which is Buddhist).
